name: Polymega Collection Vol. 23: City Connection
summary:
Jaleco was a studio that carved out its own corner of gaming history with a style that was unmistakably its own, and Polymega Collection Vol. 23 - CITY CONNECTION celebrates that wonderfully offbeat spirit with a lineup of arcade classics and console favorites packed with zany humor, unexpected twists, and the kind of creative chaos that could only come from Jaleco.

Take a joyride in CITY CONNECTION, dodge the madness of GAME TENGOKU / GAME PARADISE: MASTER OF SHOOTING, and dive into the colorful action of PLUS ALPHA, CHAMELEON, ROD LAND, SCUD HAMMER, and IGNITION FACTOR. This collection showcases a developer that was never afraid to experiment, embrace the absurd, or take an unexpected turn.
